biosphere_link.title: Row links a biosphere flow
biosphere_link.cause: A BOM row can only link an activity (a process), not an emission or resource flow.
biosphere_link.fix: Create an authored activity that carries the emission as a biosphere exchange, and link the row to it.

bom_biosphere_link.title: File refused: biosphere link
bom_biosphere_link.summary: Import refused: {count} row(s) link a biosphere flow
bom_biosphere_link.cause: A BOM row can only link an activity, and a flow can never compute. Nothing was imported.
bom_biosphere_link.fix: Fix the rows listed, or link an authored activity that carries the emission, then import again.

code_truncated.title: Truncated code
code_truncated.summary: Activity code has the wrong length
code_truncated.cause: An ecoinvent code has 32 characters. This one was cut short or mistyped.
code_truncated.fix: Copy the code again from Database Explorer, or replace the placeholder with a real code.

code_not_found.title: Code not in database
code_not_found.summary: Code not found in the database
code_not_found.cause: The database exists, but it has no activity with this code.
code_not_found.fix: Check the code and the database name, or pick the activity again in Database Explorer.

database_missing.title: Database not installed
database_missing.summary: Database not installed in this project
database_missing.cause: The row names a database this project does not hold.
database_missing.fix: Install that database, or change the row to a database you have.

code_no_database.title: Code without database
code_no_database.cause: The row has an activity code but no database name.
code_no_database.fix: Fill in Ecoinvent Database for the row.

database_no_code.title: Database without code
database_no_code.cause: The row has a database name but no activity code.
database_no_code.fix: Fill in Ecoinvent Code, or clear the database to leave the row unlinked.

name_mismatch.title: Name mismatch
name_mismatch.summary: BOM name differs from the activity name
name_mismatch.cause: The name in the BOM is not the name of the linked activity.
name_mismatch.fix: Check you linked the right activity. The link is used as it is.

location_mismatch.title: Location mismatch
location_mismatch.summary: BOM location differs from the activity location
location_mismatch.cause: The location in the BOM is not the location of the linked activity.
location_mismatch.fix: Check you linked the right activity. The link is used as it is.

unit_mismatch.title: Unit mismatch
unit_mismatch.summary: Unit differs from the activity unit
unit_mismatch.cause: The row's unit measures something other than the activity's reference unit.
unit_mismatch.fix: Change the unit, or link an activity that is measured in the same kind of unit.

stage_scope_defaulted.title: Stage scope defaulted
stage_scope_defaulted.summary: Stage scope not set, counted as inflows
stage_scope_defaulted.cause: The stage name matched no keyword and has no Scope, so it counts as production.
stage_scope_defaulted.fix: Set Scope on the stage root row: inflows, stock or outflows.

waste_sign.title: Positive quantity on a waste treatment
waste_sign.summary: Positive quantity on a waste treatment
waste_sign.cause: ecoinvent enters waste inputs as negative amounts, so a positive one gives a credit, not a burden.
waste_sign.fix: Enter the quantity as negative if you mean a burden. The row computes as entered.

unlinked_materials.title: Materials without a link
unlinked_materials.summary: Calculation stopped: materials have no linked activity
unlinked_materials.cause: Some materials have no ecoinvent activity. Computing would silently drop them.
unlinked_materials.fix: Link them in Database Explorer, then calculate again.

validation_failed.title: Unresolved links block the calculation
validation_failed.summary: Calculation blocked: rows have unresolved links
validation_failed.cause: Some BOM rows point at activities that do not resolve.
validation_failed.fix: Open the validation report and fix the rows listed.

project_state_mismatch.title: Project changed under you
project_state_mismatch.summary: The open project differs from the one the app is using
project_state_mismatch.cause: The window and the backend are on different projects, often after a restart.
project_state_mismatch.fix: Refresh the app or switch projects, then try again.

import_rejected.title: Configuration file rejected
import_rejected.summary: Import rejected: the file has errors
import_rejected.cause: The configuration workbook has problems, listed by sheet and field.
import_rejected.fix: Fix the cells listed and import the file again.

authored_validation_failed.title: Authored activity not valid
authored_validation_failed.cause: One or more rules about exchanges, pedigree or scope are not met.
authored_validation_failed.fix: Fix the problems listed, then save again.

authored_activity_linked.title: Activity is still linked
authored_activity_linked.summary: This activity is linked from BOM rows
authored_activity_linked.cause: Deleting it would leave those rows pointing at nothing.
authored_activity_linked.fix: Relink or remove those BOM rows first.

authored_database_linked.title: Database is still linked
authored_database_linked.summary: This database is linked from BOM rows
authored_database_linked.cause: Deleting it would leave those rows pointing at nothing.
authored_database_linked.fix: Relink or remove those BOM rows first.

authored_excel_rejected.title: Workbook rejected
authored_excel_rejected.summary: The workbook could not be read
authored_excel_rejected.cause: The file is not a usable .xlsx, or it is too large or unsafe.
authored_excel_rejected.fix: Download the template and copy your data into it.

authored_excel_invalid.title: Workbook has errors
authored_excel_invalid.summary: The workbook has errors: nothing was imported
authored_excel_invalid.cause: Cells in the workbook break a rule. Each error names its sheet, row and column.
authored_excel_invalid.fix: Fix every error listed, then import again.

negative_amount.title: Negative amount
negative_amount.cause: An exchange amount must not be negative here.

amount_not_positive.title: Amount not positive
amount_not_positive.cause: A zero or negative amount is not allowed for this exchange.

not_biosphere.title: Not a biosphere flow
not_biosphere.summary: {where}: flow is not in the biosphere
not_biosphere.cause: An authored activity carries biosphere flows only.

unknown_flow.title: Unknown flow
unknown_flow.cause: This project has no biosphere flow with that code.
unknown_flow.fix: Search for the flow by name and pick it from the list.

flow_type.title: Wrong flow type
flow_type.summary: {where}: not an emission or resource flow
flow_type.cause: The flow is of a type an exchange cannot use.
flow_type.fix: Pick an emission or resource flow.

bv_not_settable.title: Variance not settable
bv_not_settable.cause: ecoinvent already measures this flow's variance.

bv_required.title: Variance required
bv_required.cause: ecoinvent does not measure this flow, so you must give a value.
bv_required.fix: Enter a basic variance and the reason for it.

bv_invalid.title: Variance not valid
bv_invalid.cause: The basic variance must be a positive number.

bv_reason_required.title: Variance reason required
bv_reason_required.cause: A supplied variance needs a reason, so it can be checked later.
bv_reason_required.fix: Say where the value comes from.

below_floor.title: Variance below the floor
below_floor.cause: The value is lower than the smallest ecoinvent uses for this kind of flow.
below_floor.fix: Raise it, or give a reason for keeping it lower.

floor_reason_not_applicable.title: Floor reason not needed
floor_reason_not_applicable.cause: A floor reason applies only to a variance below the floor.

indicator_not_reached.title: Indicator not reached
indicator_not_reached.summary: {where}: indicator is not reached by any flow
indicator_not_reached.cause: A complete indicator must be reached by at least one flow of the activity.
indicator_not_reached.fix: Untick the indicator, or add a flow that reaches it.

no_exchanges.title: Activity without exchanges
no_exchanges.cause: An authored activity needs at least one exchange.
no_exchanges.fix: Add an exchange for it on the Exchanges sheet.

missing_sheet.title: Sheet missing
missing_sheet.cause: The workbook lacks a sheet the import needs.

no_header.title: Header row missing
no_header.cause: The first row must hold the column names.
no_header.fix: Put the column names in row 1.

missing_column.title: Column missing
missing_column.cause: A column the import needs is not in the header row.
missing_column.fix: Add the column, or start from the template.

template_version.title: Template version
template_version.summary: Workbook is from another template version
template_version.cause: The Read me sheet carries a template version this app does not know.
template_version.fix: Download the current template and copy your data into it.

truncated.title: More errors not shown
truncated.cause: Only the first errors are listed.
truncated.fix: Fix these and validate again to see the rest.

too_long.title: Text too long
too_long.cause: The cell holds more characters than allowed.

formula.title: Formula not accepted
formula.cause: Formulas are never evaluated on import.
formula.fix: Paste the value instead of the formula.

database_rows.title: Database sheet rows
database_rows.summary: Database sheet needs exactly one row
database_rows.cause: The Database sheet describes one database.
database_rows.fix: Keep one row on the Database sheet.

database_name.title: Database name
database_name.cause: The name is empty, too long, reserved, or contains 'biosphere' or 'premise'.
database_name.fix: Choose another name in the field below.

database_name_taken.title: Database name already taken
database_name_taken.summary: A database with this name already exists. Choose another name.
database_name_taken.cause: A database with this name is already in the project. An existing database is never overwritten.
database_name_taken.fix: Type another name in the field below and check again.

key_required.title: Activity key required
key_required.cause: The Exchanges sheet uses the key to say which activity a row belongs to.
key_required.fix: Give each activity a unique key.

duplicate_name.title: Duplicate activity
duplicate_name.summary: {where}: two activities share a name and location
duplicate_name.cause: An activity is identified by its name and location.
duplicate_name.fix: Change the name or the location of one.

example_row.title: Example row left in
example_row.summary: {where}: example row still in the file
example_row.cause: Rows whose key starts with EXAMPLE are the template's examples.
example_row.fix: Delete the example rows or replace them with your own.

scope_invalid.title: Scope not valid
scope_invalid.summary: {where}: scope must be complete or partial
scope_invalid.cause: The scope says whether the listed flows are the whole inventory.

scope_note_required.title: Scope note required
scope_note_required.summary: {where}: a partial activity needs a scope note
scope_note_required.cause: A partial inventory must say what it leaves out.

indicators_on_complete.title: Indicators on a complete activity
indicators_on_complete.summary: {where}: indicators apply to partial activities only
indicators_on_complete.cause: A complete activity already covers every indicator.
indicators_on_complete.fix: Clear the complete indicators, or set the scope to partial.

no_activities.title: No activities
no_activities.cause: A database needs at least one activity.

unknown_activity.title: Unknown activity key
unknown_activity.cause: The Exchanges sheet names an activity the Activities sheet lacks.
unknown_activity.fix: Fix the key, or add the activity.

flow_required.title: Flow required
flow_required.cause: Each exchange needs a flow code, or a flow name with its compartment.

no_lookup.title: Lookup by name not available
no_lookup.summary: {where}: flow lookup by name not available
no_lookup.cause: Name lookup is not available here.

flow_not_found.title: Flow not found
flow_not_found.cause: No flow has that name and compartment.
flow_not_found.fix: Check the spelling, or give the flow code.

flow_ambiguous.title: Several flows match
flow_ambiguous.cause: More than one flow has that name and compartment.
flow_ambiguous.fix: Give the flow code to choose one.

flow_name_mismatch.title: Flow name differs from code
flow_name_mismatch.summary: {where}: name does not match the code
flow_name_mismatch.cause: The code belongs to a flow with another name.
flow_name_mismatch.fix: Fix the name or the code.

compartment_mismatch.title: Compartment differs from code
compartment_mismatch.summary: {where}: compartment does not match the code
compartment_mismatch.cause: The code belongs to a flow in another compartment.
compartment_mismatch.fix: Fix the compartment or the code.

amount_not_number.title: Amount not a number
amount_not_number.cause: The cell holds text where a number is needed.

pedigree_missing.title: Pedigree score missing
pedigree_missing.cause: A missing score would count as no added uncertainty.
pedigree_missing.fix: Set every pedigree score from 1 to 5.

pedigree_invalid.title: Pedigree score not valid
pedigree_invalid.cause: A score must be a whole number from 1 to 5.

basis_invalid.title: Uncertainty basis not valid
basis_invalid.cause: The basis must be ecoinvent or supplied.

bv_not_number.title: Variance not a number
bv_not_number.cause: The cell holds text where a number is needed.

invalid.title: Problem in the file
invalid.cause: A rule was broken. The message says which.
invalid.fix: Read the message and fix the cell.

method_install_failed.title: Method install failed
method_install_failed.cause: The installer stopped before it finished. The message says why.
method_install_failed.fix: Read the message, fix it and install again. Nothing half-installed stays.

method_install_warnings.title: Installed with warnings
method_install_warnings.cause: Some characterisation factors were skipped because their flow is not in this project's biosphere3.
method_install_warnings.fix: The method works for the flows it found. Check the skipped list if a flow you need is missing.

import_failed.title: Import failed
import_failed.cause: The import stopped with an error. The message says why.
import_failed.fix: Read the message, fix the cause and import again.

import_cancelled.title: Import cancelled
import_cancelled.cause: You stopped the import before it finished.
import_cancelled.fix: Start it again if you still need it. Check Database Explorer for a partial database.

import_task_lost.title: Import status lost
import_task_lost.cause: The backend no longer knows this import, often after a restart.
import_task_lost.fix: Check Database Explorer to see whether the database was written.
